operations.summary: Set the programmed base value of fixture channels (the static look before modifiers). Values are normalized 0–1 (→ DMX 0–255).
Write namespaced extension data (JSON) on the project, a fixture or a live widget: data[extensionId][key] = value. `value: null` deletes the key.
Find fixtures by ids, kind, signature, channel type, group, name or bounding box (all filters AND-combined; empty filter = all).
Full detail of fixtures by id: compact view plus channels (index, type, DMX address, current programmed value 0–255, range), heads, beams, kind config and extension data.
Move fixtures to absolute positions (normalized world 0–1: x left→right, y top→bottom on the 2D canvas, same space as plugin Sample.x/y; optional z = height above the floor, normalized like x/y).
Set the yaw rotation of fixtures in degrees (0–360, clockwise on the 2D canvas). One RotateFixture command for all fixtures.
Replace the config of a generated (kind) fixture, e.g. a LED strip's pixel count or shape, and rebuild it. Only for fixtures with a `kind` (see fixtures.find).
List fixture groups (scene tree folders): id, name, parentId (nested groups) and all fixture ids inside (deep). Group ids can be used as modifier targets (targets.groupIds).
Add an empty live control page; returns its id for live.addWidget.
Add a widget (button, slider, xy pad, color, label, beat, fixture preview) to a live page; returns its id.
List live control pages with their widgets (id, type, label, color, grid position/size, mapping).
Remove a widget from a live page (undo restores it at its previous position in the widget list).
Update a widget's label, color, grid position/size and/or mapping; omitted fields stay unchanged, `null` clears label/color, `mapping` replaces the whole mapping.
Add a modifier (an effect layer such as Waveform, Noise, Sequencer or Color Shift) to the stack, like "Add" on the modifier card.
Apply one of the plugin's recipes (named complete looks, see plugins.get) to an existing modifier, like clicking it in the card's preset bar.
List the modifier stack in order (index 0 = bottom, evaluated first; the last entry is on top).
Remove modifiers from the stack by id (the whole instance, for all its target fixtures). Unknown ids fail the operation.
Reorder the modifier stack. `order` is the complete new order: every modifier id exactly once, bottom (evaluated first) to top.
Press, release or click a trigger param of a modifier like a performer on the card button / a live button: momentary input, NO undo step, not rolled back, skipped on dryRun.
Change fields of an existing modifier; omitted fields stay. params are merged by key (only the given keys change); speed merges too (omit value to keep it).
Rename a scene node: a fixture or a group (ids from project.digest / groups.list).
Compile, validate and register a content plugin (modifier) from a manifest and AssemblyScript source, then use it with modifiers.add { plugin: hash or alias }.
Full manifest (params with defaults and ranges, recipes with their params/speed/spread, distribution options) and source code of a plugin.
List the content plugins (modifier types) that can be added with modifiers.add: built-ins, your own, the project's, locally built ones and optionally public ones.
Publish a locally built plugin to the shared registry so collaborators (visibility "project", the open project), only you ("private") or everyone ("public") can resolve its hash.
Compact overview of the project: BPM, fixtures, groups, the modifier stack and live pages. Start every task with it.
Set the project tempo in beats per minute (20–300). Beat-synced modifiers (speed mode "beat") follow it.
The user's current selection in the editor: selected node ids (fixtures and groups) and the fixture ids they expand to. Use it when the user says "these fixtures" / "the selected ones".
